correctness.rationale: For cyclic Q={1,3,4,5,9}, the eleven 5-element blocks form a symmetric (11,5,2) design. Distances are two within sides and 1/3 across, yielding 34 H_1 circles at radius 1 and the asserted complete 79-facet radius-two list. The contractible A,B cover intersects in the 55-edge incidence graph, so U≃ΣG≃∨34S²; fifty-five tetrahedral 3-cells attach along incidence four-cycles. I independently reconstructed the rooted BFS chord 34×55 matrix and the listed 34-column minor and obtained exact integer determinant -1, hence 34 primitive attachments kill π_2 and leave 21 independent 3-spheres. Independently enumerated all 4776 nonempty faces and computed all 22 signed dihedral Lefschetz values: identity χ=21, nontrivial rotations -1, and all point/block-swapping reflections +1; yields Q[D22] module 1⊕2W.
